Empty authority_head may leave source discovery available, but cannot earn emitted authority because main only supplies it from an OBSERVED pre-discovery repository snapshot and later certification remains fail-closed.

When authority_head is non-empty, call assess_skill_head_content_binding(head_blob_by_path.get(relative, \"\"), content.git_blob_identity). On MISMATCH append DiscoveryError(stage=\"repository\", error_type=\"HeadSkillContentMismatch\", reason=binding.reason, sha256=sha256) and continue. On any non-MATCH unavailable result use error_type HeadSkillContentUnavailable and continue. Only append SkillRecord after both existing post-content file-identity revalidation and exact content↔HEAD binding pass.
